'''Thes Cilgris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who owned and operated the modified [[Barloz-class medium freighter|''Barloz''-class freighter]] ''[[Birthright]]'' during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Cilgris was a member of the [[Cilgris family]], a family of Duros [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], and he was the father of [[Yett Cilgris]] and the uncle of [[Naul Cilgris]].
